title: LCTFound: a lung CT vision foundation model facilitating disease diagnosis and medical imaging
core_idea: Develop a large-scale lung CT vision foundation model (LCTFound) trained via diffusion-based pretraining and joint encoding of imaging plus clinical metadata on a curated multi-center dataset to overcome labeled-data scarcity and limited generative capacity, enabling a single pretrained model to be adapted to multiple CT imaging tasks.
tldr: A multimodal foundation model for lung CT, pretrained on a large curated multi-center dataset using diffusion-based self-supervision and clinical–image joint encoding, designed to serve many downstream CT tasks (enhancement, virtual CTA, reconstruction, segmentation, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment response prediction, and 3D surgical navigation).
